text: When you create an account, we collect your name, email address, and postal address.
notes: Direct contact identifiers from GitHub Privacy Statement.

text: Users provide their full name, mailing address, and telephone number upon registering for services.
notes: Direct contact identifiers from Mozilla Privacy Notice.

text: We store your username and password to authenticate your access to the portal.
notes: Account credentials disclosure from Wikimedia.

text: Account registration requires login credentials, specifically a unique username and chosen password.
notes: Login credentials disclosure from GitHub.

text: We collect payment card information and billing details when you purchase a subscription.
notes: Payment and billing details disclosure from Apple.

text: Transactions require credit card number, expiration date, and billing address.
notes: Credit card and billing address disclosure from Cloudflare.

text: We automatically collect device telemetry: IP address and browser type.
notes: Telemetry and IP address logging disclosure from Mozilla.

text: Our web servers log MAC addresses, operating system version, and unique device identifiers.
notes: Device identifier logging from Cloudflare.

text: We track pages visited, time spent per page, and clickstream patterns.
notes: Clickstream and usage activity disclosure from GitHub.

text: Your browsing history and interaction history within our application are recorded.
notes: Browsing history tracking disclosure from Apple.

text: We collect your precise geolocation data when navigation services are active.
notes: Precise geolocation disclosure from Apple.

text: GPS coordinates and latitude and longitude are recorded during route tracking.
notes: GPS location disclosure from Apple.

text: We do not collect precise location data unless you enable the feature.
notes: Conditional collection restriction disclosure from Mozilla.

text: We do not collect biometric data unless you opt-in to the feature.
notes: Synthetic variation of conditional restriction.

text: Password hashing uses modern cryptography and salted SHA-256.
notes: Adversarial negative test: discusses password hashing as security mechanism.

text: Our corporate headquarters are located in Zurich, Switzerland.
notes: Adversarial negative test: company office location, not consumer location collection.

text: We share personal information with service providers who perform business functions on our behalf.
notes: Service provider data sharing from GitHub.

text: Outside contractors and service providers operate under strict written contracts.
notes: Contractor and service provider sharing disclosure from Mozilla.

text: We do not sell personal data to advertisers or third parties.
notes: Negative data sale commitment from DuckDuckGo.

text: We will not sell your personal data under any circumstances.
notes: Pledge not to sell personal data from Wikimedia.

text: We sell customer data and personal profile records to advertising brokers.
notes: Affirmative data sale disclosure.

text: The company sells personal information to third-party commercial partners.
notes: Affirmative data broker sale disclosure.

text: We disclose data when required by subpoena, court order, or applicable law.
notes: Legal compliance sharing disclosure from Cloudflare.

text: Disclosures may be made to law enforcement agencies in response to valid legal process.
notes: Legal disclosure requirement from GitHub.

text: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, customer records may be transferred.
notes: Business transfer and merger sharing disclosure from Mozilla.

text: If our business enters bankruptcy or asset reorganization, customer information is transferred.
notes: Asset reorganization disclosure from GitHub.

text: We share your information with our corporate affiliates and parent company subsidiaries.
notes: Corporate affiliate sharing disclosure from Apple.

text: Our affiliate marketing strategy includes promoting third-party online software tutorials.
notes: Adversarial negative test: discusses marketing strategies, not sharing data with corporate subsidiaries.

text: We deploy first-party cookies to maintain your authenticated session across page loads.
notes: First-party session cookie disclosure from Cloudflare.

text: Our website uses cookies to remember user preferences and maintain active logins.
notes: First-party cookies disclosure from GitHub.

text: Our outbound newsletters contain web beacons and tracking pixels to monitor email open rates.
notes: Web beacon and email tracking pixel disclosure from GitHub.

text: Pages may contain pixel tags or clear GIFs that log user visits.
notes: Pixel tags and clear GIFs disclosure from Mozilla.

text: We use Google Analytics and traffic analytics to measure aggregated visitor volume.
notes: Analytics cookies disclosure from Mozilla.

text: Our site deploys performance cookies and usage metrics to evaluate platform speed.
notes: Performance cookies disclosure from Cloudflare.

text: You can manage cookie preferences in your browser or adjust cookie settings.
notes: Cookie user controls disclosure from Apple.

text: Visitors can opt-out of cookies by activating the Do Not Track preference in their browser.
notes: Do Not Track and cookie controls from GitHub.

text: We do not use cookies for advertising and never use tracking pixels.
notes: Negative cookie disclosure from DuckDuckGo.

text: We do not employ third-party advertising trackers on any page.
notes: Negative advertising tracker disclosure from Wikimedia.

text: Baking chocolate chip cookies requires heating butter and sugar at 350 degrees.
notes: Adversarial negative test: baking recipe mentioning cookies, not browser cookies.

text: A maritime radio beacon broadcasts navigation warnings to ships at sea.
notes: Adversarial negative test: nautical radio beacon, not digital tracking beacon.

text: We delete or anonymize personal identifiers within ninety (90) days.
notes: Specific timeframe data retention disclosure from GitHub.

text: Data is retained for three years following the end of your contract.
notes: Explicit multi-year retention timeframe from Mozilla.

text: When you close your account, we delete eligible account data and purge account records.
notes: Account closure deletion disclosure from GitHub.

text: Upon account closure, we purge account data and delete or anonymize personal identifiers.
notes: Account termination data deletion from Apple.

text: We store data for as long as necessary to provide you with services.
notes: Vague retention timeframe disclosure from Cloudflare.

text: Personal data is kept for as long as needed to fulfill legitimate business purposes.
notes: Vague retention duration disclosure from Apple.

text: Records are retained to satisfy statutory legal retention obligations.
notes: Legal retention obligations disclosure from GitHub.

text: Data may be preserved to resolve disputes and enforce our agreements.
notes: Dispute resolution retention disclosure from Cloudflare.

text: Employee retention programs help businesses maintain skilled workers in competitive markets.
notes: Adversarial negative test: staff employment retention, not personal data retention.

text: Water retention in soil depends upon moisture levels and clay composition.
notes: Adversarial negative test: agricultural water retention, not personal data retention.

text: You have the right to access: request a copy of your personal data.
notes: Access request right disclosure from Mozilla.

text: Users can request access to their personal data by contacting customer support.
notes: Access request right from GitHub.

text: Correction: request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal records.
notes: Correction and rectification right from Wikimedia.

text: Consumers have the right to rectify their personal data if incomplete.
notes: Rectification right disclosure from Apple.

text: Deletion: request erasure of your personal data subject to lawful exceptions.
notes: Deletion request right disclosure from Cloudflare.

text: You may request that we delete your personal data from our systems.
notes: Right to erasure disclosure from GitHub.

text: Opt-out: opt out of marketing communications by updating your email preferences.
notes: Marketing opt-out disclosure from Mozilla.

text: Recipients can opt out of marketing communications via the unsubscribe link in emails.
notes: Marketing unsubscribe disclosure from Apple.

text: We support data portability allowing you to download a structured, commonly used copy of your data.
notes: Data portability disclosure from GitHub.

text: You may transfer your data in a machine-readable format to another service provider.
notes: Machine readable export disclosure from Mozilla.

text: To exercise these rights, contact privacy@example.com; we respond to verified requests within thirty days.
notes: Rights contact and response timeline disclosure from Apple.

text: Contact our privacy compliance team to submit requests; we respond to verified requests within 30 days.
notes: Privacy officer contact mechanism from Cloudflare.

text: The right turn lane allows drivers to exit the motorway safely.
notes: Adversarial negative test: vehicular right-of-way, not legal privacy rights.

text: Human rights organizations advocate for civil liberties globally.
notes: Adversarial negative test: general civil liberties, not privacy data rights.
